notes.title: Untitled
notes.content:
Queen's Garden was launched!
It's a charming match-3 game where you as master gardener help the King to build a beautiful garden for the Queen.

-100 Challenging match-3 levels
-60 garden decorations to choose from
-Several hidden object scenes and memory games as bonus
-Power ups!
-Play relaxed, timed and move restricted mode!

You can check it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2639600/Queens_Garden/
